verses.sanskrit: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्त: सर्वं प्रवर्तते .\n इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विता: ॥ ८ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaṁ sarvasya prabhavo
mattaḥ sarvaṁ pravartate
iti matvā bhajante māṁ
budhā bhāva-samanvitāḥ
verses.translation: I am the source of all spiritual and material worlds. Everything emanates from Me. The wise who perfectly know this engage in My devotional service and worship Me with all their hearts.
